unit.label: -ling
unit.core_meaning: a small, young or minor one of its kind
unit.mentor_note: Ling makes things small, and often slightly beneath the speaker: a princeling is not a prince taken seriously. Diminutives are a favourite way for authors to condescend without saying so.

members.meaning: a young plant grown from seed

predict_options.text: A small, young or minor version of something

discovery.understand_note: Ling shrinks whatever it attaches to, in size or in status. When an author reaches for it, read the tone: they are rarely being neutral.

applies.prompt: Knowing -ling makes something small or minor, what is a princeling — and what is the writer doing by choosing that word?

options.text: A minor prince — and the writer is belittling him
A prince still in training for the throne
The eldest son of a reigning king
